note: F1a: every role="alert" (and role={...'alert'...}, aria-live="assertive") under app/ and components/, NOS chrome (components/nos-chrome/) excluded, is class (a) unless listed here. (a) = error summary or page-level error: border-2 border-[var(--status-error)], aria-hidden icon, status-error text, no background tint. (b) = field-level alert of a named allowed kind. (c) = not an error (a status notice). Each entry names a file and a substring that must appear in the alert's opening tag or the 300 characters before it; an entry matching no alert FAILS the check (stale). New alerts default to (a). An entry with requireIconAndToken true must also have an aria-hidden icon and text-[var(--status-error)] in the alert.

classes.reason: TicketFieldAlert: the left-border-only field alert (border-l-2 border-error, bg-transparent, aria-hidden warning sign, error text). Golden-compliant for field errors.

Footer newsletter topics field error, INTERIM ruled treatment (lead, no-invention): NEWSLETTER_COPY.genericError is unsourced placeholder copy and is withheld by default, so the topic error is the sr-only role=alert (announced) plus a 1px --status-error-on-dark outline on the invalid checkbox, which carries aria-invalid and aria-describedby the alert; no visible summary, no fill. SWITCH-OVER: once sourced copy exists it becomes a visible left-border-only field alert (border-l-2, bg-transparent) with the aria-hidden icon in --status-error-on-dark. Gate: check-newsletter-error.mjs (topic case).
Admin settings inline field-level error with an aria-hidden icon and the error text colour; not a page-level summary.

Door scan result panel: a full-panel scan outcome for door staff (role status when valid, alert when refused), not a form error summary. Its result colours belong to the door-scanner design; restyling is out of F1a's scope.
Field-level upload error. Allowed only with an aria-hidden icon beside status-error text, never colour alone.
